newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fairfax in new Internet venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fairfax in new Internet venture.

text.p: Newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to launch a community-based online information service in Australia in a joint venture with Big Colour Pages Partner.
The service will provide a one-stop interactive local city information resource including entertainment, retail and other local information online, Fairfax said.
The service will be based on the CitySearch service which was launched in the U.S. seven months ago (www.citysearch.com) and which is growing rapidly across U.S. cities, it said.

"Fairfax mastheads have been the trusted information source for local information for over 150 years and we are committed to adding value to newspaper-based information and entertainment in its broadest sense," chief executive officer Bob Muscat said.

"The Internet has opened up many opportunities in the publishing industry and Fairfax is ideally positioned at the forefront of technology to capitalise on these opportunities as they arise," he said in a statement.
Fairfax said Sydney and Melbourne are planned to go online in the second half of 1997. It said this is the first time that the CitySearch service has been brought outside the U.S.

Fairfax said the venture plans to build CitySearch in Australia with support from local businesses and community groups. The new service will be a content-rich web site that provides access to local information 24 hours a day, it said.
The publisher said CitySearch users in the U.S. were able to chose among five main areas, restaurants and hotels, arts and entertainment, community, shops and services and news.
It said users can either browse these categories or find more specific information based on keywords, location and time.
Fairfax is 19.9 percent owned Brierley Investments Ltd . -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
